$comment: Gzip byte budgets per asset group in apps/web/dist/assets, matched by filename regex and extension-agnostic. Checked by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs after `npm run build`. An entry (file or directory) in dist/assets that matches no exclude rule and no group fails the build, so a new kind of asset has to be budgeted on purpose. A group with `minFiles` set fails loud instead of reporting a vacuous `ok` if it ends up with fewer members than that; omit it only when the group is allowed to be legitimately empty, and say why beside the group. Raise a budget only with a reason in the commit message; it exists so a regression fails CI instead of being noticed on a phone.

exclude.name: sourcemaps
exclude.reason: vite.config.ts emits build.sourcemap: "hidden" for local debugging only; apps/web/Dockerfile deletes every *.map before the image ships, so these bytes never reach a phone and budgeting them would budget nothing real.

groups.name: art
groups.note: No minFiles: this group is legitimately empty until ARB-223 wires the Toy Box atlas imports into the client, unlike vendor/app, which the build must never emit zero chunks for.
